Context: 11. Special provisions to CGHS beneficiaries aged 80 years and above

## 11. Special provisions to CGHS beneficiaries aged 80 years and above  
- Consultation of Doctor at CGHS Wellness Centre without standing
- (a) in Queue.  
R  
- (b) CGHS Doctors shall enquire by phone, at least once in a month to enquire about their well being/make a home visit if residing
- within 5 kms. of CGHS WC.
- (c) Settlement of medical claims on priority out of turn.
